text: Ive been trying to get through for ages so please someone actually read this. Im a foster carer, I have a 2 year old girl staying with me, her temp is 39. About half an hour ago she had what I think was a fit, she went all stiff and then her arms and legs were shaking and her eyes rolled back. Shes never done that before, not that Im aware of anyway, and I dont have much of her history yet. Then when I was changing her I noticed spots. Shes got dark skin so I honestly couldnt see much on her body, but I checked the palms of her hands and the bottoms of her feet and looked inside her lower eyelids like I read you should, and there are tiny purpley dots. I pressed a glass on her palm and they didnt fade at all, I could still see them thru the glass. I might be doing it wrong I dont know. I need to know what to do with her right now please, not be on hold again
